steps: Open the reviewed V1.1 build on an approved HTTPS test origin in physical iPhone Safari.
Use Share → Add to Home Screen and open the installed app.
Record device/iOS version, standalone launch, icon, safe areas and both orientations.
On a physical device, open the exact reviewed build over HTTPS and load a compatible model.
Grant camera access, verify genuine live inference, then deny permission in a fresh session.
Record capture behavior, explanatory denial handling and track shutdown after stopping.
Authorize camera access on a device with multiple cameras or a connected USB camera.
Switch each enumerated camera while inference is active and then disconnect an external camera.
Record real labels, frame transitions, resource release and disconnect feedback.
Read actual camera track capabilities on the physical browser/device.
If native zoom is exposed, change supported values and record returned settings and frame behavior.
If unavailable, verify the explicitly labelled digital-crop fallback and source-coordinate overlays; do not claim control of all iPhone lenses.
Start camera/video inference on a physical device, then background or lock it.
Verify camera tracks stop and file playback pauses.
Return and explicitly resume; check that no obsolete worker result or duplicated loop is shown.
On physical iPhone, iPad and Android browsers, request fullscreen from the reviewed workspace.
Record whether native Fullscreen API or the viewport fallback is used.
Verify aspect ratio, overlay coordinates, camera/zoom controls, orientation and exit behavior.
